# Business Requirements Document (BRD)

## Project Overview

### Project Name
OptimAlze Buddy

### Project Description
OptimAlze Buddy is an AI-powered digital services agent designed to serve as a single conversational interface for government and municipal services. It enables citizens to retrieve accurate public service information, complete service-related actions such as appointments and form submissions, and upload and validate documents in real-time. The system leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and document intelligence to automate and simplify citizen-government interactions.

## Business Objectives

- **Enhance User Experience:** Streamline citizen interactions with government services by providing a unified, efficient, and error-free digital experience.
- **Reduce Administrative Burden:** Minimize repetitive queries and document processing workload for government staff.
- **Improve Service Delivery:** Enable faster and more accurate service execution through automation and intelligent document validation.

## Problem Statement

Citizens face significant friction when interacting with government and municipal bodies due to:

- Fragmented information spread across complex websites
- Manual navigation of multiple portals for basic services
- High rejection rates caused by incorrect or poor-quality document uploads
- Overloaded administrative staff handling repetitive queries
- Lack of real-time guidance during service applications

These inefficiencies result in poor user experience, administrative backlog, and delayed service delivery.

## Proposed Solution

OptimAlze Buddy acts as a 24/7 digital clerk that unifies information access, service execution, and document validation into a single AI-driven interface. Key features include:

- Accurate, policy-grounded answers using RAG
- Conversational task execution (appointments, form submissions)
- Real-time document pre-screening to prevent errors
- Reduced workload for government staff

## Scope of Work

### In-Scope

- Development of an AI-powered conversational interface
- Integration with existing government and municipal systems
- Implementation of RAG-based information retrieval
- Automation of appointment booking and form submissions
- Real-time document verification using computer vision

### Out-of-Scope

- Development of new government databases or systems
- Manual processing of documents and queries

## Functional Requirements

| ID  | Requirement Description                                                                 | Priority |
|-----|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|
| FR1 | The system shall provide RAG-based information retrieval to ensure accurate responses.   | High     |
| FR2 | The system shall enable users to book appointments through a conversational interface.   | High     |
| FR3 | The system shall support conversational form filling to reduce data entry errors.        | Medium   |
| FR4 | The system shall perform real-time document verification using computer vision.          | High     |
| FR5 | The system shall differentiate between information and action requests.                  | Medium   |
| FR6 | The system shall be available 24/7 to provide continuous support.                        | High     |

## Non-Functional Requirements

| ID  | Requirement Description                                                                 | Priority |
|-----|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------|
| NFR1| The system shall ensure zero-hallucination responses for information retrieval.          | High     |
| NFR2| The system shall maintain compliance with public sector workflows and regulations.       | High     |
| NFR3| The system shall provide a user-friendly interface for all citizens.                     | Medium   |
| NFR4| The system shall be scalable to accommodate increasing user demand.                      | Medium   |

## Market Position

- **Category:** GovTech, Public Sector AI, Intelligent Digital Assistants
- **Positioning:** A purpose-built AI agent for government and municipal operations, not a generic chatbot.
- **Key Differentiators:**
  - RAG-based zero-hallucination responses
  - Action-capable agent (not just informational)
  - Built-in document validation using computer vision
  - Designed specifically for public sector workflows and compliance

## Target Audience

- Municipal and local government bodies
- Public service departments (certification, licensing, registration)
- E-governance and digital transformation initiatives
- Citizens interacting with government services
- Administrative and case management teams

## Feature–Benefit Analysis

| Feature                             | Benefit                                                                 |
|-------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| RAG-based information retrieval     | Accurate, policy-verified answers with no hallucinations                |
| Unified conversational interface    | Eliminates the need to navigate multiple web portals                    |
| Appointment booking automation      | Faster service access and reduced staff workload                        |
| Conversational form filling         | Reduces user confusion and data entry errors                            |
| Real-time document verification     | Prevents incorrect or low-quality submissions                           |
| Computer vision-based file validation| Ensures only valid applications enter the system                        |
| Intent-aware task execution         | Differentiates between information and action requests                  |
| 24/7 availability                   | Continuous citizen support without human intervention                   |

## Assumptions

- Citizens will have access to the internet and basic digital literacy.

## Constraints

- Integration with legacy systems may require additional resources.
